G1.evidence: Nevada does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Nevada on the discipline of State Bar of Nevada members, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 173 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Nevada on the discipline of State Bar of Nevada members, 1992 to 2025. 1 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Nevada publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 23 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 456 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2012-09-27, so it has been operating for more than a year

json_ld_descriptions: Battle Born Injury Lawyers is a Nevada personal injury law firm with an office in Las Vegas. The firm’s Las Vegas personal injury attorneys have more than 85 years of combined experience representing accident victims across the state against negligent parties and their insurers. The firm handles all types of accident cases, including car accidents, slip and fall accidents, medical malpractice, and other situations in which you suffered an injury due to someone else’s actions. Since the firm was founded in 2010, our lawyers have helped the firm’s clients recover over $100 million dollars in injury compensation. Contact Battle Born Injury Lawyers to schedule a free consultation with a Las Vegas personal injury lawyer.
